svg.text: Only the endorsed build ships, and it ships safely and reversibly. The project team decides go-live after consulting the client.
Humans and AI prepare and run the release
and scan tools, policy as code
Every ▼ attribute and failing check is escalated (illustrative)
Act on failing checks and every
Code defects go back to Build.
Infrastructure gaps go back to Design.
The acceptance rate of recommendations calibrates the validator
and is the evidence for graduating this loop toward the cockpit.
The project team decides go-live after consulting the client. This is an explicit
human decision, not an automatic one. Operate takes over once the release is live.
